title: 🤖 AI Context Profile Generator
subtitle: Generate custom context instructions tailored for your daily workflows in under two minutes.

form.rolePlaceholder: e.g., Senior Systems Administrator, Civil Engineer, Web Developer
form.toolsLabel: Core Tools, Technologies, or Standards Used Daily:
form.toolsPlaceholder: e.g., Linux, Docker, WireGuard, IEEE Standards, AutoCAD

toneOptions.direct: Direct & Technical (No fluff, straight to solution)

modeOptions.absolute: Absolute Mode (Direct answer immediately, skip meta-talk or planning)
modeOptions.cot: Chain-of-Thought (Show step-by-step reasoning before final output)
modeOptions.socratic: Socratic Mode (Ask guiding questions to lead to the solution)
modeOptions.critic: Critical Review Mode (Analyze potential edge cases and flaws first)

form.constraintsLabel: Things the AI Must ALWAYS AVOID:
form.constraintsPlaceholder: e.g., Do not repeat my prompt back to me, skip generic intros/outros, show complete code/configs without truncated blocks.

chatgpt: Click your Profile Picture in the bottom-left corner.
Paste the generated text into the box labeled: How would you like ChatGPT to respond?
claude: Click your Initials / Profile Name in the bottom-left corner.
Select Styles & Preferences (or open a Project for context scope).
Paste the generated profile into the Custom Instructions text area.
gemini: Open Gemini and click Settings (⚙️) in the left sidebar.
Select Saved Info / System Instructions (if available in your tier).
Alternatively, paste this profile into the first prompt of a new thread.

template.styleSub: - Skip basic concepts or definitions unless explicitly requested. Assume domain-level familiarity.
template.constraintsSub: - Provide complete code, scripts, or configuration blocks without truncated placeholders.
